title: Company OKR Convergence Playbook and Decision Radar
creator: Priya Desai
description: Goal: Produce a lightweight, repeatable playbook and an interactive 'Decision Radar' that helps execs and initiative owners converge company-level OKRs with cross-functional initiatives. The deliverables are: 1) a written playbook that standardizes how initiatives are mapped to OKRs, how dependencies are captured, and how escalation paths operate; 2) a Decision Radar prototype (interactive visualization) that surfaces initiative health, blocking dependencies, committed owners, and decision urgency; 3) a rollout plan and training materials for PMs and Eng leads. This is intended to reduce planning friction, shorten decision cycles on cross-team trade-offs, and make company-level tradeoffs visible during quarterly planning.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook draft reviewed and approved by Product, Eng, and Design leadership
Decision Radar prototype demonstrates ability to display >50 initiatives with filters for OKR alignment, owner, region, and risk
Dependency registry seeded with at least 2 quarters of historical initiatives and annotated critical-path items
Run a pilot workshop with 3 cross-functional teams and capture feedback; incorporate feedback into v1
Rollout plan with training session and one-page cheat sheet published in Confluence
success_metrics: Reduce cross-team decision latency for priority initiatives from median 12 days to <=5 days within one quarter
Increase visibility: 95% of initiative owners report that Decision Radar clarifies upstream/downstream dependencies in post-pilot survey
Fewer undocumented dependencies reported in PM gating reviews (baseline -> target: -60%)
